# Stack

Lays out children vertically, with spacing from the token steps. Use it to stack page blocks, form groups and
drawer content.

**Category**: Primitives · **Common uses**: Stacking blocks, form fields and lists vertically; replaces hand-written layout classes and layout CSS

## Import

```ts
import { Stack } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Vertical arrangement with a default gap of step 3 (12 px).

```tsx
import { Box, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        First block
      </Box>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        Second block
      </Box>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        Third block
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Tight and loose gaps

Gaps only take steps 0–8, consistent across the application.

```tsx
import { Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Gaps() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={5}>
      <Stack gap={1}>
        <Text weight="semibold">Title</Text>
        <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
          A description right below its title uses step 1
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap={1}>
        <Text weight="semibold">Another group</Text>
        <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
          The two groups are separated by step 5
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Form group

Step 4 between form fields, the button at the bottom aligned to the right.

```tsx
import { Button, Input, Stack, Text } from 'vellum-ui'

export function FormGroup() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4} padding={4}>
      <Text overline>Details</Text>
      <Input aria-label="Name" placeholder="Name" />
      <Input.TextArea aria-label="Description" placeholder="Description" rows={3} />
      <Stack align="end">
        <Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Space between children, as a spacing step. | `3` | No |
| `padding` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 7 \| 8` | Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted. | — | No |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'stretch' \| 'baseline'` | Horizontal alignment of the children. | `'stretch'` | No |
| `justify` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end' \| 'between'` | Vertical distribution of the children (takes effect when the container has spare height). | `'start'` | No |
| `grow` | `boolean` | Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline. | — | No |
| `scroll` | `boolean` | Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows (and lets the container shrink). | — | No |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'section' \| 'header' \| 'footer' \| 'nav' \| 'aside' \| 'main' \| 'ul' \| 'ol' \| 'li'` | HTML element to render, for semantics (`ul` / `li` for lists, `section` for page regions, and so on). | `'div'` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
